title: The fair
content: Has anyone had the “fair grounds” or the carnival where ur walking through the fair and there’s the games and Ferris wheel? I had one last night I never play any of the games or go on any rides (that i remember) but I’ve had this place in my dream before. I also dream of a playground it’s different sometimes cause I usually dream of my childhood playground but there’s something different about it sometimes but last night and in the past I’ve also dreamt of different random playgrounds and for some reason every single time I have a dream where I’m at a park it’s ALWAYS nighttime. Last night I was at the fair and then suddenly was at a park by a lake and it was dark and there was a long tree that u could climb on. It always seems to be the same type of locations it’s so interesting…
